With only 46 countries supported out of 195, Stripe's model excludes entire economies. This isn't a temporary inconvenience—it's a structural reality. PayPal compounds the issue with arbitrary 180-day fund holds and no appeal process. This post compares the real alternatives, focusing on base-layer infrastructure that gives creators permanent ownership and control, not temporary workarounds.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-honest-side-side-13|COREMERCH guide to lemon]] Squeezy, and Paddle offer centralized platforms with varying degrees of convenience. Stripe provides robust APIs but requires banking infrastructure it doesn't provide in excluded countries. PayPal offers global reach but retains ultimate control over your funds. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy simplify product delivery but depend on Stripe or PayPal for payments. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, uses open tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create a stack you own. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions. Full control over hosting, payment verification, and product delivery.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on financial regulations, perceived risk, or lack of local banking partnerships. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy inherit these restrictions since they rely on Stripe or PayPal. Paddle offers more country coverage but still operates as a centralized gatekeeper. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses these restrictions entirely. It uses globally accessible tools like Cloudflare Workers and BSC/Solana/TRON networks for crypto payments. The system doesn't care where you're located—it cares that your payment confirms on-chain. Your store operates under your rules, not a platform's terms of service.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments quickly but charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, plus potential currency conversion fees. Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no monthly fees or hidden charges. Transaction fees on BSC, Solana, or TRON networks average under $0.10. The real cost difference lies in ownership. With sovereign infrastructure, you pay a one-time fee for deployment (e.g., Edge Commerce Stack at $197) and own the system forever. Platforms charge recurring fees and can change their terms at any time. Infrastructure sovereignty means predictable costs and no platform rent.
Platforms exclude you based on geography. Infrastructure doesn't care where you're located.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal own your payment data and can suspend your account without warning. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy control your product delivery process. Sovereign infrastructure puts you in control. Your order data lives in your Supabase database. Your files deliver from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket. Payment verification happens automatically via NOWPayments webhooks. The system runs on your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own the code, the data, and the process. Automation happens on your terms, not a platform's.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a Stripe-supported country and value convenience over control, platforms might suffice temporarily. But for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other excluded regions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. It requires a one-time investment in setup (e.g., Edge Commerce Stack) but delivers lifetime ownership and operational freedom. Choose this architecture if you want to build on infrastructure you control, not rent access from platforms that can exclude you at will. The tradeoff is clear: convenience versus sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

To sell digital products without Stripe or Gumroad, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions by using globally accessible tools. Payments confirm on-chain, triggering automatic product delivery from your own file storage. The system operates independently of any centralized platform, giving you full control over your store and customer data.
Owning your commerce stack means no platform can suspend your account or hold your funds.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators searching for Stripe alternatives in Nigeria or looking to sell digital products without Gumroad should consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments into a fully deployed system. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to see how this stack provides permanent infrastructure sovereignty. For those wanting to build their own, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers complete documentation and source code.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack by first setting up a Cloudflare Pages account for hosting. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, selecting BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees. Load your digital products into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test end-to-end functionality before going live. Ensure SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are configured for email deliverability. Own your infrastructure—don't rent it.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I really accept payments from anywhere with this system?

Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with no buyer account required. Payments confirm on-chain, triggering automatic product delivery. The system works globally because it uses open networks, not centralized platforms.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a verification layer, not a custody service. Payments confirm directly on the blockchain. If NOWPayments experiences issues, your funds remain secure on-chain. You retain full access to your payment data in Supabase.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are immutable, eliminating chargeback fraud. Once a payment confirms on-chain, the funds are yours. This removes a major risk platforms use to justify excluding certain countries.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for scalability. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic efficiently, while Supabase scales with your order volume. Add more products by uploading them to your file storage. The system grows with your business.
What if I need help after deployment?

The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support for any issues. For ongoing assistance, COREMERCH offers consulting services. The system is also fully documented, giving you the knowledge to maintain and modify it yourself.
Sovereign infrastructure turns payment restrictions into a solved problem, not a recurring hurdle.
